procurement.policy.portal.description: Workspace-wide portal access. Enabling this portal allows approved public and unlisted tenders to be served; it does not publish drafts.
procurement.policy.portal.loadError: Unable to load portal settings. Check your access and retry.
procurement.policy.portal.saveError: Portal save was not confirmed. Reload its status before retrying.
procurement.policy.portal.separate: Portal access is separate from tender visibility and global-directory permission. Save this card separately; policy changes below do not enable the portal.
procurement.policy.page.realWorkspace: Select a real workspace to manage procurement. Demo saves are not supported.
procurement.policy.page.description: Manage defaults and rules for new procurement workflows. Existing commerce documents are unchanged. Unsaved edits are discarded when switching workspaces or screens.
procurement.policy.page.demo: Demo mode cannot save procurement policies. Exit demo mode to manage a real workspace.
procurement.policy.page.discardDescripti: Your local draft will be replaced with the latest saved policy for this workspace. This cannot be undone.
procurement.policy.settings.generalDescr: Defaults are stored for this workspace only. They do not publish tenders or change operational documents.
procurement.policy.settings.listing: Allow global listing (publication still requires explicit opt-in)
procurement.policy.settings.fallbackDesc: Block is the safe initial fallback. None is an explicit no-approval configuration, not authorization to order or pay.
procurement.policy.settings.deadlinesDes: Each time window is independent. Expiry never grants approval.
procurement.policy.settings.exceptionsDe: Enabled exceptions require a supervisor, justification and a separate supervisor decision. AI recommendations are not executed here.
procurement.policy.settings.urgentDescri: Urgency does not waive mandatory requirements or automatically accept the first supplier response.
procurement.policy.settings.urgentWarnin: Mandatory requirements are always preserved. Notifications and delegated AI are not executed by this configuration screen.
procurement.policy.settings.notification: Notification preferences do not change approval outcomes. No notifications are sent by this release.
procurement.policy.rule.description: Edits are part of the workspace draft. Use Save policy to persist changes.
procurement.policy.rule.name: Rule name
procurement.policy.rule.conditionsDescri: Empty scopes match all. Requirements from matching active rules accumulate; requisition and offer events are separate.
procurement.policy.rule.operatorsDescrip: Gt: greater than; Gte: at least; Lt: less than; Lte: at most; Eq: equal; Between: inclusive. No currency conversion is assumed.
procurement.policy.rules.description: Draft rules do not match simulations. Archive instead of deleting to retain the rule in policy history.
procurement.policy.rules.name: Name
procurement.policy.rules.empty: No rules match this view. Create a rule to configure conditions and requirements.
procurement.policy.rules.editDescription: Changes remain in your policy draft until Save policy is selected.
procurement.policy.stage.name: Stage name
procurement.policy.stage.aiDescription: AI authority is configuration only. This release does not execute AI reviews or decisions.
procurement.policy.requirement.name: Requirement name / standard
procurement.policy.requirement.descripti: This defines a requirement; it does not verify a credential, collect evidence or run an AI review.
procurement.policy.simulator.title: Policy simulator — simulation only
procurement.policy.simulator.description: Evaluates the current draft, including unsaved edits. It never approves, publishes, orders, pays, verifies evidence or runs AI. Ready means a plan can be described, not authorization.
procurement.policy.simulator.linesDescri: For product/category or matching-line rules, add lines. Their net amounts must equal the document total. No FX conversion is performed.
procurement.policy.simulator.stale: Inputs or policy changed. Run the simulation again; the result below is stale.
procurement.policy.simulator.ready: Simulation only: Plan ready — not approved
procurement.policy.simulation.only: Simulation only: no approvals, AI decisions, or downstream operations are executed.
procurement.policy.simulation.dateRange: Deadline is outside the supported date range.
procurement.policy.simulation.fallbackBl: The effective fallback blocks progression until an explicit policy is configured.
procurement.policy.simulation.fallbackNo: The configured fallback explicitly requires no approval; this is not transition authorization.
procurement.policy.simulation.businessCa: Business calendar {{calendar}} must be resolved by an authorized calendar service.
procurement.policy.simulation.lines: {{name}}: line inputs are required to evaluate scope.
procurement.policy.simulation.classifica: {{name}}: product/category classification is missing for a required scope.
procurement.policy.simulation.requester: {{name}}: requester is required to evaluate self-approval restrictions.
procurement.policy.simulation.selfApprov: {{name}}: self-approval restrictions make the configured quorum impossible.
procurement.policy.simulation.fx: {{name}}: no authorized dated FX conversion from {{from}} to {{to}}.
procurement.policy.simulation.timeout: {{name}}: deadline reached; timeout action is {{action}}, never approval.
procurement.policy.simulation.aiDecision: {{name}}: AI decision is not executed by this simulator.
procurement.policy.simulation.aiRecommen: {{name}}: AI recommendation is not executed by this simulator.
procurement.policy.simulation.conflict: Conflicting requirement {{id}}; no rule may overwrite another requirement.
procurement.policy.feedback.session: Your session expired. Sign in again to manage procurement.
procurement.policy.feedback.permission: Only workspace owners and administrators can manage procurement.
procurement.policy.feedback.conflict: This policy changed in another session. Your draft has not been saved. Reload the latest policy and reapply your changes.
procurement.policy.feedback.storage: Procurement storage is unavailable. The required migration may not be installed. No changes have been confirmed.
procurement.policy.feedback.request: The policy request failed. No changes have been confirmed. Reload to check the current revision before retrying.
procurement.policy.feedback.invalidRespo: The saved policy response is invalid. Editing is blocked to protect the existing configuration.
procurement.policy.feedback.unconfirmed: The save response could not be confirmed. Reload the latest policy before retrying.
procurement.policy.feedback.saved: Policy saved as revision {{number}}. Configuration only; no live enforcement has started.
procurement.policy.validation.timestamp: Use a valid timestamp and UTC offset
procurement.policy.validation.timeZone: Use a valid IANA time zone
procurement.policy.validation.businessCa: Business durations require a business calendar
procurement.policy.validation.delegatedA: Automatic AI requires explicit delegated agent authority
procurement.policy.validation.separateHu: Use a separate human stage for human approvals
procurement.policy.validation.singleAgen: One agent cannot manufacture multiple votes
procurement.policy.validation.humanAppro: A human stage requires eligible approvers
procurement.policy.validation.automaticA: Only automatic AI may hold delegated decision authority
procurement.policy.validation.mandatoryA: Mandatory humans must be eligible approvers
procurement.policy.validation.credential: Only certification requirements must specify credential semantics
procurement.policy.validation.currency: Use an uppercase three-letter currency code
procurement.policy.validation.range: An inclusive range requires an upper bound at least equal to its lower bound
procurement.policy.validation.upperBound: Upper bounds are only allowed for ranges
procurement.policy.validation.effectiveE: Effective end must follow effective start
procurement.policy.validation.distinctRe: Requirement identifiers must be distinct within a rule
procurement.policy.validation.activeSupp: Active supplier rules require a proposal count
procurement.policy.validation.supervisor: Enabled exceptions require an explicit supervisor
procurement.policy.validation.lineTotal: Line net amounts must equal the document net total
procurement.policy.validation.numberMin: Use a number greater than or equal to {{number}}
procurement.policy.validation.numberMax: Use a number less than or equal to {{number}}
procurement.policy.timing.description: Timing is configuration only. No timer runs or approval by silence. Days/weeks are elapsed 24/168 hours, not local calendar arithmetic. Business calendars require external resolution.
